creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen once, 2026-10-21 ~23:55, in a full ./dev on main (4b21a66a) on the Mac mini at load 17.1 with swap in use: across_machines::a_machine_restarted_under_a_tab_spanning_machines_needs_nothing_written_back found the restarted devenv's copy at ("X", 2), where it expects ("[~A@laptop|X 0.50]", 1) - a window wrote the devenv a tree without the laptop's pane A. It passed 5 of 5 alone. The investigation that followed found and fixed two other routes to a wrong prune in the same test, both dropping the devenv's X rather than the laptop's A (b0aaf6f6: a stopping daemon's closes, and a rejoining part not yet reconciled), and could not reproduce this one in about 160 runs, ten at a time. Dormant: nothing in the product writes a spanning tree before MIP-8 stage 3. Next time it fails, keep the run's daemon and window logs: they show which merge wrote X alone, and with which parts. Settle it before stage 3 makes spanning tabs real.
title: A restarted machine's copy of a spanning tab was written without the other machine's pane
